s: Yeter dine hasseder ubo l"g seipim: ap al pi shennatal yadayv letzorek tibbul hayraqot, ap al pi ken tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv lasseuda ulebarek "al netilat yadayim" achar gemar hahaggada vehahallel, lepi shebbishat amirat hahaggada vehahallel hissiach dato mishshemirat yadayv, veyesh lachosh shemma naga bimqom hattinnopet, shehayyadayim asqaniyyot hen:

Veap im bishat amirat hahaggada vehahallel lo hissiach dato mishshemirat yadayv, ap al pi ken tzarik lachazor velittol yadayv lasseuda belo beraka, lepi keshennatal yadayv letzorek tibbul hayraqot lo haya bedato shettaaleh lo netila zo lasseuda, vekol hannotel yadayv ledabar shettibbulo bemashqeh — en netila zo ola lo leekol lechem im lo haya dato lekak bishat netila, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch. Veim keshennatal yadayv letibbul hayraqot haya dato shettaaleh lo netila zo gam lasseuda — en tzarik lachazor velittol lasseuda im lo hissiach dato mishshemirat yadayv bishat amirat haggada vehallel. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla en nakon laasot ken, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"d:

Ap al pi shebbekol yom tob chayyab haadam libtzoa al lechem mishneh kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqk"t, mikkol maqom belel pesach yesh omerim sheen tzarik ki im achat umechetza, lepi shemmah sheddareshu chakamim mimmah shekkatub "lechem oni" chaser va"v, shettehe hammatztza perusa kedarko shel ani — lo dareshu ella ligroa millechem mishneh, sheachat mehem lo tihyeh shelema. Veyesh omerim shello dareshu ella lehosip al lechem mishneh, shemmillebad b' matztzot shelemot shetztzarik libtzoa alehen kemo bishar yom tob — tzarik lihyot od perusa achat mishshum "lechem oni". Veken hamminhag pashut, veen leshannot ella bishat haddechaq, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tp"b:

Vetzarik sheyyochaz shette hashshelemot beyado bishat birkat "hammotzi", vehapperusa tihyeh ben shette hashshelemot, velo yanniach happerusa milmala, lepi shebbattechilla tzarik lebarek "hammotzi" veachar kak "al akilat matztza", ubirkat "hammotzi" hi al hashshelema ubirkat "al akilat matztza" hi al happerusa, shehi "lechem oni", veim happerusa tihyeh milmala — yitztarek laabor al hammitzvot kesheyyebarek "hammotzi" battechilla:

Uleachar sheggamar birkat "hammotzi" — yesh lehashmit hashshelishit hashshelema min yado, veyeechoz bapperusa millematta ubehaelyona milmala vibarek "al akilat matztza". Abal lo yashmit miyyado matztza hashshelema haelyona qodem birkat "al akilat matztza", veen tzarik lomar shello yibtza mimmenna kelum ad leachar gemar birkat "al akilat matztza", lepi sheyyesh omerim shebbirkat "hammotzi" hi al happerusa, shehi "lechem oni" ubirkat "al akilat matztza" hi al hashshelema, lepikak tob latzet yede shenehem, ulebarek battechilla shette berakot ellu, veachar kak yibtza kezayit mehaelyona hashshelema ukezayit mehapperusa. Veap al pi shebbishbil birkat "hammotzi" bilbad en tzarik libtzoa kezayit meiqqar haddin, ella apillu kol shehu yakol lebarek "hammotzi", mikkol maqom kevan shebbishbil birkat "akilat matztza" tzarik libtzoa kezayit, sheal pachot mikkezayit eno yakol lebarek, sheeno yotze yede chobato bepachot mikkezayit, veim ken lehaomerim shebbirkat "al akilat matztza" hi al hashshelema haelyona — tzarik libtzoa mimmenna kezayit, velassebara harishona (shehi iqqar) shebbirkat "al akilat matztza" hi al happerusa — tzarik libtzoa kezayit min happerusa, lepikak latzet yede shenehem tzarik libtzoa kezayit mizzo ukezayit mizzo:

Ushene kezayit ellu tzarik leoklam beyachad, dehaynu sheyyaknisem lepiv bebat achat, sheim yokal mittechilla et hakkezayit shel "hammotzi" dehaynu shel hashshelema veachar kak yokal hakkezayit shel "akilat matztza" dehaynu shel happerusa — yihyeh mapsiq ben birkat "al akilat matztza" laakilat kezayit mehapperusa baakilat matztza kezayit mehashshelema, veken lehaomer shebbirkat "hammotzi" hi al happerusa, im yokal mittechilla hakkezayit mehapperusa veachar kak hakkezayit mehashshelema — hare hu mapsiq ben birkat akilat matztza laakilat kezayit mehashshelema, lepikak yaknisem lepiv bebat achat. Abal en tzarik lebolam bebat achat, ella yerasseqem bepiv, veyibla battechilla kezayit echad kullo bebat achat, veachar kak yibla kezayit hashsheni bebat achat:

Veim eno yakol lerasseq bepiv shene hazzetim beyachad — yokal battechilla hakkezayit shel "hammotzi", dehaynu shel hashshelema lepi sebara harishona (shehi iqqar), veachar kak hakkezayit shel "akilat matztza", veen akilat hakkezayit shel "hammotzi" chashub hepseq bediabad ben birkat "al akilat matztza" laakilat kezayit mehapperusa, kevan shehu letzorek oto kezayit, dehaynu letzorek birkat "hammotzi" shetztzarik lebarek gam al oto kezayit shel happerusa:

Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad apillu lo akal ella kezayit echad bilbad, ben mehashshelema ben mehapperusa, vaapillu akal bazeh achar zeh baakilot harbeh, im en mittechillat akila rishona ad sop akila acharona yoter mikkede akilat peras, dehaynu g' betzim (ayyen siman try"b) — yatza. Vaapillu hesiach harbeh beemtza hakkezayit ben akila laakila — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek "al akilat matztza", veen tzarik lomar "hammotzi", kevan shello hesiach ben beraka litchillat haakila (ayyen siman tl"b):

Kesheokel battechilla hakkezayit shel "hammotzi" veachar kak hakkezayit shel "akilat matztza" — tzarik lehaseb gam baakilat kezayit shel "hammotzi", dehaynu kezayit shel hashshelema. (Kede latzet gam lehaomerim shehakkezayit shel hashshelema alayv hu mebarek "al akilat matztza" ubo hu yotze yede chobato, veeno yotze ella bahasibba. Veap al pi shelledibrehem tzarik leekol techilla hakkezayit shel happerusa dehaynu shel "hammotzi" veachar kak kezayit shel hashshelema, mikkol maqom im hippek en bekan issur gamur ap lepi dibrehem. Ella shellekattechilla nakon haddabar lehaqdim hakkezayit shel happerusa lepi dibrehem shebbirkat "hammotzi" shemmebarek battechilla hi al happerusa, abal haiqqar hu kassebara harishona shebbirkat "hammotzi" shemmebarek battechilla hi al hashshelema, ulepikak tzarik lehanniach happerusa tachat hashshelema qodem habbetzia, shello yitztarek laabor al hammitzvot, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Velaken okel battechilla hakkezayit mehashshelema, veen anu chosheshin lassebara haacharona ella bedabar sheen bo chashash ap lepi sebara harishona, kegon leekol kezayit shalem mehashshelema bahasibba):

Yesh nohagin letabbel bemelach et hakkezayit shel "hammotzi" veshel "akilat matztza". Ubimdinot ellu en nohagin ken, lepi sheppat neqiyya en tzarik melach, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z. Veap shebbishar yemot happesach matbilin hammatztza bemelach ap shehi neqiyya, mikkol maqom beb' lelot ellu shel pesach — en nohagin ken, mippene chibbub matztza, latzet yede chobato bematztza sheen immah taarobet taam acher kelal. Abal meiqqar haddin en lachosh lazeh. (Abal letabbel hammatztza bemashqin — yesh limnoa meiqqar haddin, kemo shennitbaer besiman ts"a):

Achar sheakal hakkezayit shel akilat matztza — yiqqach miyyad kezayit maror vishaqqeennu kullo bacharoset, kede lehamit et haqqappa (perush min tolaat yesh bammaror vehu met al yede hacharoset) shebbammaror shello yazziqennu. Veakshav en nohagin leshaqqeo kullo, ella betibbul miqtzato. Veyesh shemmeyashshebin hamminhag, lepi sheqqappa zeh eno matzuy benenu, veen matbilin bacharoset ella mishshum mitzva, shehu zeker lattit. Veap al pi ken en mebarekin alayv, lepi shehu tapel lammaror veniptar bebirkat hammaror:

Veachar shettibbelo bacharoset — yebarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al akilat maror", velo yebarek qodem hattibbul, lepi sheyyesh litkop habberaka laasiyyat hammitzva, dehaynu haakila bekol mah sheepshar. Ukeshehu metabbelo bacharoset — yizzaher lehotzio miyyad, velo yashhennu betoko, shemma yitbattel taam merirato al yede haqqiyyuha shebbacharoset. Umittaam zeh tzarik lenaer hacharoset mealayv miyyad leachar hattibbul:
Ap al pi sheen tzarik lehaseb baakilat maror mittaam shennitbaer besiman ta"b, mikkol maqom im ratza lehaseb rashshay:

Ap al pi shebbammatztza tzarik libloa kol hakkezayit bebat achat lekattechilla, mikkol maqom bammaror im qasheh alayv libloa kezayit bebat achat — yesh lismok al mi sheomer sheen tzarik libloa kol hakkezayit bebat achat, ella yakol lebolo meat meat, ubilbad shello yishheh mittechilla vead sop yoter mikkede akilat peras:

Mitzvat maror min hattora enah ella bizman shehappesach neekal, shenneemar "al matztzot umerorim yokluhu", abal bizman hazzeh eno ella middibre soperim shettiqqenu zeker lammiqdash. Abal chiyyub akilat matztza ballayla harishon ap bizman hazzeh hu min hattora, shenneemar "baereb toklu matztzot", velo huzkar sham pesach:

Lepikak, im karak adam kezayit matztza ukezayit maror uleasan yachad vaakalan bizman hazzeh — lo yatza yede chobato, shehammaror shehu middibre soperim mebattel et taam hammatztza shehi min hattora. Abal bizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam shehammaror hu gam ken min hattora — yatza yede chobat matztza vide chobat maror, lepi shemmitzvot shel tora enan mebattelot zo et zo, sheshshequlin hen keachat, shekkullan qiyyum mitzvotayv shel haqqadosh baruk hu hen. Velo od, ella shellepi daat hillel hazzaqen en adam yotze yede chobato min hattora ella im ken korek kezayit pesach ukezayit maror ukezayit matztza veokelan beyachad, leqayyem mah shenneemar: "al matztzot umerorim yokluhu":

Veap bizman hazzeh shemmaror eno ella middibre soperim umatztza hi min hattora, veim kerakan beyachad vaakalan eno yotze yede chobato ap lepi daat hillel, shehammaror mebattel et taam hammatztza, veim ken chayyab hu leekol kezayit matztza bilbaddah belo maror latzet yede chobat matztza min hattora, mikkol maqom eno yotze yede chobat maror lepi daat hillel ella im ken notel od kezayit matztza vekoreko im kezayit maror veokelan beyachad, shehare maror bizman hazzeh tiqqenuhu chakamim zeker lammiqdash, shehaya az chiyyubo min hattora, ubizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam eno yotze yede chobat maror min hattora lepi daat hillel ella im ken koreko im hammatztza, lepikak gam akshav tzarik lekorko im matztza:

Ulepi shecholeqin alayv chaberayv al hillel veomerim sheen tzarik lekorkam kelal, lo min hattora bizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam velo middibre soperim bizman hazzeh, ulepi dibrehem im okel battechilla kezayit matztza bilbaddah veachar kak okel kezayit maror bikrika im kezayit matztza — lo yatza yede chobat maror, lepi shekkezayit matztza shebbakkerika hi reshut veen bah shum mitzva lepi dibrehem, vahare hu mebattel et taam hammaror shebbakkerika keshelloasan yachad. Abal lepi daat hillel shehammatztza shebbakkerika hi choba middibre soperim — enah mebattelet et taam hammaror shehu gam ken choba middibre soperim, vehen: zeh kezeh, veenan mebattelin zeh et zeh. Vekevan shello nipseqa halaka lo kehillel velo kachaberayv, lepikak latzet yede shenehem — tzarik adam sheyyokal kezayit matztza bilbad belo maror, vibarek "al akilat matztza", shebbikzayit zeh hu yotze yede chobato min hattora ap lepi daat hillel, veachar kak tzarik sheyyokal kezayit maror bilbad belo matztza, vibarek "al akilat maror", shebbikzayit zeh hu yotze yede chobat maror lepi dibre chaberayv, veachar kak yikrok kezayit matztza ukezayit maror veyoklem beyachad zeker lammiqdash kehillel, velo yebarek al kerika zo lo birkat hammatztza velo birkat hammaror, shemma halaka kachaberayv veen bikrika zo shum mitzva, veap lepi daat hillel hu yotze bebirkat hammatztza vehammaror shebberak kebar. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello lehasiach bedabar sheeno meinyan hasseuda mishshebberak "al akilat matztza" ad sheyyokal kerika zo, kede shettaaleh beraka zo ubirkat hammaror gam likrika zo lepi daat hillel. Veim abar vesach — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek al kerika zo, shemma halaka kachaberayv. Abal im abar vesach ben habberaka lehatchalat akilat hammatztza o hammaror — tzarik lachazor ulebarek im sach bedabar sheeno meinyan hasseuda. Vaapillu bedabar shehu meinyan hasseuda — en lehasiach lekattechilla ben habberaka lehatchalat haakila. Veyesh nizharin bazeh shello lehasiach bedabar sheeno meinyan hasseuda mishshebberak "al akilat matztza" ad sheyyokal haapiqoman, kede shettaaleh beraka zo gam laakilat apiqoman. Vechumra yetera hi. Nohagin bimdinot ellu lomar qodem akilat kerika zo: "ken asa hillel bizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam haya korek matztza umaror ku'". Veen mazkirin pesach ap shehillel haya korek gam kezayit pesach bikrika zo, mikkol maqom kevan sheanu omerim: "ken asa", veanu en lanu pesach — lepikak en mazkirin oto. Umikkol maqom, hammazkir — lo hipsid:

Hammaror shel kerika zo en tzarik letoblo bacharoset, shekkebar qiyyem mitzvat charoset betibbul maror rishon. Vegam en lachosh laqqappa shebbemaror zeh sheokelo im matztza bikrika. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shetztzarik letoblo bacharoset, shehare kerika zo hi zeker lammiqdash kehillel, vehillel haya meqayyem mitzvat charoset bemaror zeh shebbakkerika, shehare lo haya okel maror kelal qodem kerika zo. Vehamminhag bimdinot ellu kassebara harishona, abal haiqqar hu kassebara hashsheniyya:

Kerika zo — yesh omerim sheen tzarik hasibba, kevan sheokelin bah maror, umaror en tzarik hasibba. Veyesh omerim shetztzerika hasibba, kevan shemmatztza tzerika hasibba. Veap shekkebar akal matztza bahasibba, mikkol maqom kerika zo hi zeker lammiqdash kehillel, vehillel lo haya okel matztza qodem kerika zo, ubammatztza shebbikrika zo hu yotze yede chobato, vehaya tzarik lehaseb baakilatah, lepikak gam anachnu tzerikim lehaseb. Veken iqqar, kemo shennitbaer besiman ta"b. Umikkol maqom, bediabad sheshshakach veakal belo hasibba — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, veen tzarik lachazor veleekol bahasibba:

Hammatztza vehammaror shebbikrika zo — tzarik libloa otah bebat achat. Ulekattechilla yizzaher libloa kol hakkezayit matztza bebat achat im kol hakkezayit maror keshehen merussaqim bepiv, ella im ken qasheh alayv libloa b' hazzetim bebat achat, sheaz yakol libloa meat mikkezayit zeh umeat mikkezayit zeh bebat achat, veachar kak yachazor veyibla meat mikkezayit zeh umeat mikkezayit zeh bebat achat, ad sheyyokal kol hashshene zetim:

Mi sheen lo shum yeraqot leekol betibbul qodem amirat hahaggada ki im mine yeraqot sheyyotzeim bahem yede chobat maror — yebarek alehem "al akilat maror" keshemmatbilam bechometz o beme melach qodem amirat hahaggada, veen tzarik leekol mehem kezayit, veachar kak, achar sheakal hakkezayit shel "akilat matztza" — yatbil kezayit maror bacharoset veyoklennu belo beraka, shei epshar lo lebarek al akila zo "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al akilat maror", kevan shekkebar akal mimmenu qodem laken. Veap shemmapsiq harbeh ben birkat "al akilat maror" lehakkezayit maror sheokel achar hammatztza — en bekak kelum, kevan shemmiyyad achar habberaka taam meat mehammaror — hare hitchil bammitzva, veen kan hepseq ben habberaka litchillat asiyyat hammitzva. Umikkol maqom, apillu akal kezayit maror o yoter battibbul sheqqodem amirat hahaggada, ap al pi ken tzarik lachazor veleekol kezayit achar akilat matztza, lepi shehaakila harishona enah ella kede lehatmiah hattinoqot, ubaakila hashsheniyya hu sheyyotze yede chobat maror, shekkak hi hammitzva lekattechilla, shello latzet yede chobat maror qodem sheyyatza yede chobat matztza, shenneemar "al matztzot umerorim":

Ukesheokel mehammaror qodem amirat hahaggada — yebarek alayv "bore peri haadama" qodem birkat "al akilat maror" im hu rauy laakila keshehu chay, kegon chazeret vekayyotze bah, abal im eno rauy laakila kelal keshehu chay, kegon hattamka (sheqqorin qarin) vekayyotze bo — eno mebarek alayv ki im birkat "al akilat maror":

Vekol zeh keshei epshar lo limtzo shear yeraqot, abal im epshar lemotzam — tob lachazor acharehem, shello yitztarek lebarek "al akilat maror" keshemmetabbelo qodem amirat hahaggada, sheyyesh mi sheomer sheen nakon laasot ken. (Veayyen beyoreh dea siman rtz"v mah hem hammine yeraqot):

Bala matztza velo leasah — yatza ap al pi shello hirgish taam matztza bepiv, dekevan shennehena gerono mimmenna — hare zo niqret akila. Abal lekattechilla tzarik leloosah ad sheyyargish tamah bepiv. Abal im bala maror velo leaso ad sheyyargish taam merirato bepiv — lo yatza, shehattora hiqpida lemarer piv shel okel, zeker le"vaymareru et chayyehem":

Bala matztza umaror keechad, ap al pi shello yatza yede chobat maror — yatza yede chobat matztza. Velo ameru shehammaror mebattel et taam hammatztza, ella keshelloasan yachad, sheaz hu margish taman bepiv, velaken mebattel taam hammaror shehu middibre soperim et taam hammatztza shehi min hattora, abal keshebbolean beli leisa sheen margish taman kelal — en hammaror mebattel et hammatztza:

Vaapillu im hammaror karuk sebib hammatztza venimtza shehu chotzetz ben hammatztza lebet habbelia — en bekak kelum, kevan sheshshenehem mine maakal — hare hen kemin echad, umin bemino eno chotzetz. Abal im karak hammatztza besib ubelaah — lo yatza, shehassib sheeno min maakal chotzetz ben hammatztza lebet habbelia, veen derek akila bekak:

Akal matztza belo kavvana, shello nitkavven latzet yede chobato baakila zo — yatza. Velo ameru shekkol hammitzvot sheasaan shello bemitkavven, dehaynu shello nitkavven latzet yede chobato baasiyya zo lo yatza yede chobato, ella bemitzvot sheen bahen hanaat haggup kelal, kegon qeriat shema (besiman s'), uteqiat shopar (besiman tqp"t), unetilat lulab (besiman trn"a), vekayyotze bahen, shekkeshello nitkavven baasiyyatan leshem mitzva — lo qiyyem hammitzva kelal, sheeno ella kemitasseq beolma, veen asiyyato niqret asiyyat mitzva. Abal mitzvot hatteluyot baakila, kegon pesach matztza umaror vekayyotze bahen, kevan sheyyesh bahen hanaa laggup, ap shello nitkavven latzet baakila zo — yatza yede chobato, shehare al korcho nehena haggup meakila, vahare zo niqret akila, venimtza sheqqiyyem mitzvat haakila. Ulepikak apillu lo ratza leekol matztza ukepauhu nokrim o listim leoklah — yatza yede chobato baakila zo, kevan shebbeal korcho nehena mimmenna gupo:

Vekol zeh keshehu yodea shellayla zo pesach veshezzo hi matztza ella sheakalah shello bemitkavven o shello birtzono, abal im lo yada shehallayla pesach veakal matztza apillu birtzono, veken apillu im yada shehallayla pesach, ella shehaya sabur leekol basar venizdammena lo matztza vaakalah kesabur shezzehu basar — lo yatza baakila zo. Abal im akal maror beinyan zeh — yatza, lepi shemmaror bizman hazzeh middibre soperim, vekol mitzva middibre soperim en tzarik kavvana. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheggam hammitzvot middibre soperim tzerikot kavvana, lepi shekkol mah shettiqqenu chakamim tiqqenu keen shel tora. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem, lachazor veleekol maror bekavvana belo beraka:

Abal im akal beinyan zeh belel yom tob shel galuyyot ap shehu middibre soperim — ap al pi ken tzarik lachazor veleekol ledibre hakkol, sheen lechalleq kelal ben yom tob rishon lesheni beshum dabar, shello yabou bo lezalzel al yede ken:
Mi sheakal matztza keshehu nikpa beet shetuto veachar kak nitrappe — chayyab leekol achar shennitrappe, lepi sheakila rishona hayeta beshaa shehaya patur mikkol hammitzvot:

Veen chiyyub akilat matztza ella ballayla harishon bilbad, shenneemar "baereb toklu matztzot". Abal shear kol hallelot vekol hayyamim — eno muzhar ella shello leekol chametz, dehaynu sheim rotzeh leekol pat shennillosha bemayim — yizzaher shello tabo lide chimmutz, ella yopenna keshehi matztza shello nitchammetza adayin. Veal zeh omra tora: "shibat yamim tokal matztzot", kelomar velo chametz. Abal im lo ratza leekol kelal pat shennillosha bemayim ella shear mine maakalim — hareshut beyado. Veap shebbeyom tob chayyab leekol pat kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"ch, mikkol maqom yakol leekol pat shennillosha beme perot shehi matztza ashira (veayyen siman ts"b shebbimdinot ellu en nohagin bematztza ashira kelal). Abal "lechem oni" en tzarik leekol ella ballayla harishon bilbad, shenneemar "sheshet yamim tokal matztzot ubayyom hashshebii atzeret vego'", hare yom hashshebii hu dabar shehaya biklal, veyatza min hakkelal lelammed, shehare haya biklal "shibat yamim tokal matztzot", vekan yatza yom hashshebii mikkelal akilat matztza, lelammedka sheen choba leekol matztza bayyom hashshebii, vekol dabar shehaya biklal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed, lo lelammed al atzmo yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza, dehaynu shekkol hashshibat yamim eno muzhar leekol matztza ella shello leekol chametz al derek shennitbaer. Yakol ap ballayla harishon ken? Talmud lomar: "baereb toklu matztzot", hakkatub qebao choba. Umishsheakal kezayit — yatza yede chobato min hattora:
